name: Drafts
description: Editable channel drafts (sales opener / LinkedIn post / client memo) tied to an approved action, kept behind a review gate until approved.

agentPrompts.label: What drafts are waiting on me?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-ai-newsroom` skill in this folder, then show me the sales-opener, LinkedIn post, and client-memo drafts still awaiting a decision, with their linked action and any risk badges.

agentPrompts.label: Save my edit to this draft
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-ai-newsroom` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then write the revised wording I give as the `edited-body` on the draft I name, without creating a separate file or record.

agentPrompts.label: Record my decision on this draft
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-ai-newsroom` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then write the verdict I give — approve, request changes with a comment, or block — directly onto the draft I name. Approving here never posts or sends it anywhere by itself.
